svg.aria-label: A 4 by 4 systolic array drawn as a bench-top machine. Square pucks carrying the values of matrix A ride four row tracks from a feeder on the left; round pucks carrying matrix B ride four column tracks from a feeder at the back. Each feeder holds its row's or column's pucks with a staircase offset, which is the input skew. Every clock step all pucks move one station; where a square and a round puck dock at the same station, that station multiplies them and its dial needle advances by one multiply-accumulate. A clock dial at the back corner counts the ten feed steps.
